name: Tio
source: Tio is a level 0 human magic user in a party with The Hero. The Hero was once 30 year old Yamaguchi Yoshio who was killed outside a convenience store and reborn into this fantasy world. Anything is legal in this world, even sex with children! So after Tio is poisoned by accidentally stepping into a trap The Hero will use medicine and sex to make her feel better.
